evidence.claim: In September 1895, Army signalmen used Mount Ellen as one end of a 183-mile visual message line.
evidence.quote: Over several days beginning on September 10, 1895, a detachment of the U.S. Army Signal Corps established the world heliograph record from stations atop Mount Ellen, Utah and Mount Uncompahgre, Colorado.

evidence.claim: Mirrors eight inches across flashed signals toward Mount Uncompahgre in Colorado, with telescopes used to read them.
evidence.quote: The record for visual signaling was established utilizing mirrors 8 inches across and telescopes. The flashing signals communicated over a distance of 183 miles.
